desc: Sound the trumpets. Er ... Bugles. We took everything you love about Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal and created a sweet Bugles flavor you can share with friends and family. Every cone-shaped piece is blasted with the epic cinnamon and sugar combination we call Cinnadust. Crunchy and irresistibly delicious, it's perfect for snacktime, or anytime. If you're looking for a quick and easy snack idea, it doesn't get more awesome than this. Enjoy by the bowlful, handful or forkful (hey, we don't judge). Just reach into the bag, pop them into your mouth and enjoy. Grab a fistful as you're headed out the door, pack a snack for when you're on the go, enjoy it as a bedtime snack, or have a bag ready for a midnight snack (or when your host your kids' next sleepover). Bugles Crispy Corn Snacks makes great, delicious fun for both kids and kids at heart. Contains one three oz snack bag.
features:
• CRISPY CORN SNACKS: Bugles, the first cone-shaped corn snack; Bugles Cinnamon Toast Crunch features the epic cinnamon and sugar combination we call Cinnadust
  • CINNAMON TOAST CRUNCH FLAVOR: Amp up your snack game with Bugles Cinnamon Toast Crunch; Every cone-shaped piece is blasted with the epic cinnamon and sugar combination we call Cinnadust
  • PARTY SNACK: Sweet crispy corn snacks perfect for parties or to use at a moment's notice; The epic Cinnadust flavor is sure to be a hit with the entire family
  • ON-THE-GO SNACK: Light, airy and uniquely crunchy snacks perfect for the lunchbox or a grab and go snack as you head out the door
  • CONTAINS: three oz
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Vegetable Oil (coconut and/or palm), Sugar, Fructose. Contains 2% or less of: Cinnamon, Salt, Distilled Monoglycerides, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
